标了m但有点难度。 关键点一个在于星号可以标记是否有左儿子，因此对每个节点增加一.en: Marked with 'm' but a bit difficult. The key point is that an asterisk can indicate whether there is a left child, so add a cnt for each node to record how many children have been processed. Another point is to open an array to record the most recent node at the i-th level.
